## Problem
Swap/backup/undo files may fail to be created due to long names.

## Solution
Use `vim.fs.slug()` to generate shorter file names(`maxlen` is 64).

close #7073, close #8137, close #16159

comment_regular_data.body: cool, this will be a nice, long-needed change.

Let's plan to merge this ASAP after 0.13 release

Do we need to "migrate" the old swap/backup filenames?

> Do we need to "migrate" the old swap/backup filenames?

I'd be happy to do more here, but I'm not sure what the best approach would be. e.g. maybe fall back to the old filenames when reading them? Or provide a separate script to help migrate them?

> e.g. maybe fall back to the old filenames when reading them?

I think that's best. Hopefully it's just a single util functon than can be shared. So wherever we call slug(), if not found then try the `%` format.

If that isn't too complicated then we can just leave it at that, and don't really need to bother "migrating" the old `%` names. We can just permanently(?) fallback to them. 

The benefit is that (1) new names will be shorter, (2) will support longer filepaths (which may have failed entirely with the old format).
